result.summary: Found a visible content placeholder/debug string and a minor horizontal clipping issue in the restaurant carousel.

issues.description: The section header shows the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a user-facing title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the untranslated key with the correct localized display text before releasing the page.

issues.description: The restaurant carousel on the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off on the right edge, leaving the third card partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal padding or carousel item sizing so the partial card looks intentional and doesn't appear clipped.
